searchText: Hi <@!361447803194441738> , I am looking at https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/190 and I have a question. Are any endpoints expected to return a `500` response when the node is optimistically synced? My instinct tells me that the answer is "no" because validator should use the metadata field to figure out what to do. Also what about https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/?urls.primaryName=dev#/Validator/produceBlockV2 ? Shouldn't this endpoint also include the `execution_optimistic` field? sorry didn't make it :*( i got the pr in today but wasn't familiar with our internal api middleware at the time so it's still unavailable merged now
